sweep.statement: C-366 proposes EPICON tiering — graduated pre-execution constitutional gate (EP-1/EP-2/EP-3) with policy-based classification, reconstructability semantics, and fail-closed EP-3 behavior.

signals.statement: EPICON Tiering v0.1 draft: EP-1 low-risk record / EP-2 meaningful state change / EP-3 consequential action; acting agent never self-classifies; unknown types default EP-3.
Constitutional EPICON JSON Schema (2020-12) ships with MEC citation regex aligned to C-365 Option B grammar; .dat chain prev_hash compatible.

watch_items.note: Seal quorum review pending for EPICON tiering spec v0.1.

decisions.decision: Propose EPICON tiers EP-1/EP-2/EP-3 as constitutional gate semantics
decisions.rationale: Graduated witness requirement scales with consequence; closes Goodhart surface on self-classification.

decisions.decision: Define replay as reconstructability (evidence hash chain), not model reproducibility
decisions.rationale: Hosted LLMs are non-deterministic; canon must not promise bitwise re-derivation.

decisions.decision: Spec-first delivery — no runtime gate implementation in C-366
decisions.rationale: Same pattern as MEC and tokenomics; quorum reviews grammar before code enforcement.
